## 3. Perishable Products

### 3.1 General rule

Due to food-safety regulations, **perishable products cannot be physically
returned**. This includes all items tagged as "refrigerated" or "frozen," fresh
produce, bakery items, and any item with an expiration date within 14 days of
delivery.

### 3.2 Quality issues

If a perishable product arrives in unsatisfactory condition (spoiled, past its
expiry date, incorrect temperature, wrong item), you may request a refund or
replacement:

- Submit a request **within 48 hours** of delivery.
- Include **at least one photo** showing the issue.
- A refund or replacement is issued without requiring the item to be returned.

### 3.3 Taste or preference

Perishable items returned for reasons of taste or preference ("I didn't like
it," "I changed my mind") are **not eligible for a refund or exchange**. We
encourage customers to review product descriptions, ingredients, and reviews
before purchasing.

## 2. Non-Perishable Products

### 2.1 Eligibility

Non-perishable products (canned goods, dry goods, household items, cleaning
supplies, personal care) may be returned if:

- The return request is made **within 30 days** of delivery.
- The item is **unopened and in its original packaging**.
- The item is **not a final-sale or clearance item** (marked "Vente finale" on the
  product page).

### 2.2 Process

1. Log in to your Boréal Marché account and navigate to "Order History."
2. Select the order and click "Request a return."
3. Choose the items you wish to return and provide a reason.
4. Print the prepaid return label that is emailed to you.
5. Ship the item(s) within 7 days.

Once we receive and inspect the returned items, a refund is processed to the
original payment method within 5 business days.

### 2.3 Return shipping cost

For non-perishable returns, the return shipping cost is borne by the customer
unless the return is due to a Boréal Marché error (wrong item shipped, item
defective on arrival). A flat return shipping fee of $7.95 is deducted from the
refund.

## 4. Damaged or Defective Items

Items that arrive damaged (broken packaging, crushed, leaking) or defective are
eligible for a full refund or replacement regardless of whether they are
perishable or non-perishable. Report the issue within 48 hours with a photo.

## 5. Wrong Item Received

If you receive an item you did not order, contact us within 48 hours. We will
arrange for the wrong item to be picked up at no cost and send the correct item
or issue a full refund.

## 7. Subscription Orders

Customers subscribed to recurring deliveries (Boréal Box) may cancel individual
upcoming deliveries up to 72 hours before the scheduled dispatch date. Deliveries
already dispatched follow the standard return rules above.

To cancel a subscription entirely, go to "My Account" → "Subscriptions" →
"Cancel." Active loyalty points earned through the subscription are retained.

Based on our documents: ## 2. Delivery Windows

### 2.1 Standard Delivery

Standard delivery is available for all orders. Delivery windows are assigned
based on the zone and the time the order is confirmed:

- **Orders confirmed before 14 h (Eastern)** are dispatched the same business day.
- **Orders confirmed after 14 h** are dispatched the next business day.
- Saturday orders are dispatched on Monday.
- Statutory holidays (federal and provincial) are non-dispatch days.

Customers receive an email with a tracking number once the order is dispatched.
A two-hour delivery window is communicated by SMS on the morning of the delivery
day.

### 2.2 Express Delivery

Express delivery is available in Zones 1 and 2 for an additional fee. In Zone 1,
same-day delivery is offered for orders placed and paid before 11 h Eastern. In
Zone 2, express orders are delivered next business day.

Express delivery is not available for orders exceeding 30 kg total weight or for
orders containing oversized items (items marked "LTL" in the catalogue).

### 2.3 Click-and-Collect

Free pickup is available at our Montréal warehouse (4300 rue Saint-Ambroise,
suite 200) and our Québec City depot (1150 boulevard Charest Ouest). Orders are
ready within 4 hours of confirmation. Uncollected orders are held for 48 hours
and then cancelled with a full refund.

Based on our documents: ## 4. Cold-Chain and Temperature-Sensitive Products

### 4.1 Refrigerated items

Products tagged as "refrigerated" (dairy, deli meats, fresh juices, prepared
meals) are shipped in insulated packaging with gel ice packs rated for the
transit duration of the delivery zone. The packaging maintains a temperature
between 0 °C and 4 °C for up to 48 hours.

### 4.2 Frozen items

Products tagged as "frozen" (frozen fruits, ice cream, frozen meals) are shipped
in insulated containers with dry ice. Frozen shipments are only available for
Zones 1 and 2. Orders containing frozen items that are shipped to Zone 3 or
Zone 4 will have those items removed and refunded. The customer is notified by
email before dispatch.

### 4.3 Ambient items

Products that do not require temperature control (canned goods, dry pasta,
snacks, cleaning supplies) are shipped in standard cardboard boxes.

### 4.4 Mixed Orders

An order can contain refrigerated, frozen, and ambient items. The order is
packed in separate containers per temperature class. All containers ship together
in one delivery.

Based on our documents: ## 2. Priority Allergens

Health Canada identifies the following priority allergens. All Boréal Marché
products must declare the presence of these allergens on the product page and
on the physical label:

1. Peanuts
2. Tree nuts (almonds, Brazil nuts, cashews, hazelnuts, macadamia nuts, pecans,
   pine nuts, pistachios, walnuts)
3. Sesame seeds
4. Milk
5. Eggs
6. Fish (all species)
7. Crustaceans and shellfish
8. Soy
9. Wheat and triticale
10. Mustard
11. Sulphites (at 10 ppm or more)
12. Gluten sources (wheat, rye, barley, oats — unless certified gluten-free)

Based on our documents: ## 2. Earning Points

### 2.1 Base earning rate

Members earn **1 point per $1 spent** (before taxes, after discounts). Shipping
fees do not earn points.

### 2.2 Bonus categories

Certain product categories earn bonus points:

| Category | Earning rate |
|----------|-------------|
| Cuisine Boréal (prepared meals) | 2× (2 points per $1) |
| Organic products (tagged 🍃) | 1.5× (1.5 points per $1) |
| Boréal Box subscription | 2× (2 points per $1) |
| Wine and spirits | 1× (standard rate) |
| Gift cards | 0× (no points) |

### 2.3 Welcome bonus

New members receive **200 bonus points** upon placing their first order of $50 or
more.

### 2.4 Birthday bonus

Members who have provided their date of birth receive **100 bonus points** on
their birthday month, credited on the first day of the month. The birthday
bonus must be redeemed within 60 days.

### 2.5 Referral bonus

When a member refers a new customer using their unique referral code, both the
referring member and the new customer receive **150 bonus points** after the new
customer's first order of $50 or more is delivered.

### 2.6 Review bonus

Members earn **10 points** for each product review (text review of at least 50
characters), up to a maximum of 10 reviews per calendar month.

Based on our documents: ## 3. Tiers

The program has three tiers based on cumulative spending in a rolling 12-month
period:

| Tier | Annual spend | Perks |
|------|-------------|-------|
| 🌱 Pousse (Seedling) | $0 – $499 | Base earning rate |
| 🌲 Sapin (Fir) | $500 – $1,499 | 1.25× earning multiplier; free standard shipping on orders over $50; early access to seasonal products |
| ❄️ Étoile (Star) | $1,500+ | 1.5× earning multiplier; free express shipping on all orders; dedicated support line; annual 10% birthday coupon; invitation to tasting events |

Tier status is evaluated on the first day of each month. If a member's rolling
12-month spend drops below a tier's threshold, they are moved to the appropriate
lower tier. A one-month grace period applies.

Based on our documents: ## 3. Shipping Fees

| Zone | Standard fee | Express fee | Free-shipping threshold |
|------|-------------|-------------|------------------------|
| Zone 1 | $6.95 | $12.95 | $75.00 |
| Zone 2 | $9.95 | $17.95 | $100.00 |
| Zone 3 | $14.95 | $24.95 | $150.00 |
| Zone 4 | $19.95 | $34.95 | $200.00 |

Shipping fees are calculated per order, not per item. The free-shipping threshold
applies to the subtotal before taxes. Promotional codes that reduce the subtotal
may cause shipping fees to apply even if the original subtotal exceeded the
threshold.

Based on our documents: ## 6. Special Diets

Boréal Marché provides informational tags to help customers following special
diets:

| Tag | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| 🌿 Vegan | Contains no animal-derived ingredients; may be produced in a facility that processes animal products |
| 🥛 Lactose-free | No lactose; may still contain milk proteins |
| 🌾 Gluten-free | Certified gluten-free (< 20 ppm) by a recognised body |
| 🥜 Peanut-free | Does not contain peanuts; may contain tree nuts |
| ☪ Halal | Halal-certified by a recognised Canadian certification body |
| ✡ Kosher | Kosher-certified (COR, MK, or OU) |
| 🍃 Organic | Certified organic under the Canada Organic Regime |

These tags are informational only and do not replace the ingredient list or
allergen declarations. Customers with severe allergies should always contact
the manufacturer directly for confirmation.

Based on our documents: ## 6. Account Rules

- Points are non-transferable between accounts.
- Points have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for cash.
- A member may hold only one loyalty account. Duplicate accounts will be merged;
  the point balances are combined but duplicate bonus credits are removed.
- Boréal Marché reserves the right to cancel points earned through fraudulent
  activity (e.g., fake reviews, self-referrals, returning items after redeeming
  points on the same order).

Redemption is available in increments of 500 points. Points and dollar discounts
cannot be combined on the same order with other promotional codes unless the
promotion explicitly allows it.

From time to time, Boréal Marché offers exclusive products redeemable only with
points (e.g., limited-edition gift baskets, branded merchandise). These products

### 4.3 Charitable donations

Members can convert points into donations to partnered food banks:

- 500 points = $5 donation to Moisson Montréal
- 500 points = $5 donation to Banques alimentaires du Québec
